offering_description.value: LICT sells broadband internet and phone service to households, businesses and public institutions in rural communities. Its local operating companies deliver these services over fiber, copper and fixed wireless networks and provide network access and data transport to other carriers.

primary_services.value: Broadband internet; local and long-distance phone service; wholesale network access and data transport; television service in select markets

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households in rural communities; B2B: Local businesses and telecommunications carriers; B2G: Public schools and local government offices

end_markets.value: Residential communications; business connectivity; education and local government; wholesale telecommunications

revenue_model.value: subscription: Monthly internet, phone and television plans; service fees: Wholesale network access and data transport for other carriers; other: Universal service support for rural network deployment and operations

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Builds and operates local networks that connect homes, businesses and public institutions; service provider: Uses its local networks to deliver broadband and phone service to subscribers and transport to carriers

geography_served.value: US regional: Rural markets in California, Iowa, Kansas, New Mexico, Utah and Wisconsin

specialization.value: related lines: Broadband, phone, wholesale network access and transport, and television over local telecommunications networks

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local operating companies sell service plans directly to subscribers and network services to carriers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Local telephone carrier authorizations, FCC and state utility commission oversight, and universal service obligations

notes: The current state-by-state footprint and availability of television service are uncertain.
